recommendation: Keep the empty external-repo audit commit for core FHIR. If the remaining usageReason/adherence duplication should be revisited, reconcile that work against the OO incubator IG source that now owns DeviceUsage, not against current core.
issue_request: FHIR-32829 was a Published R5 OO change request asking to rename DeviceUseStatement/DeviceUsage.usageReason to usageStatusReason because it explained usage status rather than clinical reason. The approved Persuasive with Modification resolution instead created a DeviceUsage.adherence backbone with code and reason children and example adherence value sets.
initial_application: Commit 41cf190393 added DeviceUsage.adherence, DeviceUsage.adherence.code, and DeviceUsage.adherence.reason to source/deviceusage/structuredefinition-DeviceUsage.xml for FHIR-32829. The Jira comment cites commit 734790a30b, which removed isSummary from DeviceUsage.adherence. The older usageStatus and usageReason elements remained in the R5 DeviceUsage source and publication.
additional_context: FHIR-26308 is related background: it accepted earlier pre-applied DeviceUsage changes, including the same usageReason naming concern. Current core source no longer builds DeviceUsage: source/fhir.ini has no active DeviceUsage resource entries, build.fhir.org/deviceusage.html returns 404, and commit 3b38b80cf2 removed DeviceUsage build metadata while redirecting current core narrative links to the OO incubator DeviceUsage artifact.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Editing source/deviceusage/structuredefinition-DeviceUsage.xml would only modify an out-of-build core file, while active current-core pages point implementers to the external OO incubator DeviceUsage artifact.
